message.content: {"class":"INSUFFICIENT_DATA","reasoning":"The timeout tie-break makes a bare timeout without supporting evidence INSUFFICIENT_DATA; the SocketTimeoutException alone does not show how far the request got. ENVIRONMENT_CONFIG and PRODUCT_DEFECT remain possible, as does TEST_CODE_DEFECT if the test's timeout was too short for normal completion. The deciding evidence is the server-side log for this request, showing whether it arrived and when processing completed relative to the timeout."}
